messages.author: a5ca085497920157
messages.subject: rhfmt feedback
parts:
I am converting my test cases to the new demands of Rhipe .73.  You have been busy.


I wanted to give some feedback on rhfmt:

> rhfmt("test", "text")
Error in match(x, table, nomatch = 0L) : 
  argument "type" is missing, with no default


The formals of rhfmt are function(..., type).

By putting the ... in front of type you make it impossible to use argument order based calls to rhfmt.  As a general matter of R style I think people put "..." at the end to avoid that.

If it gets changed to rhfmt(type, ...) then you can still use the same call as you have been using:

rhfmt("path/to", type="text")

and the "path/to" will get matched to the "...".  So there is no change to existing code.

It is just that now people can also do 

rhfmt("text", "path/to") if they should so desire.

messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] Re: rhfmt feedback
parts:
It completes correctly (R version 3.0.0, protobuf 2.5, pseudo-distributed).  It even rhreads correctly as text.  It just seems like if I trace it I will find a piece of code under rhwatch that assumes the output is sequence when it is text.


  ################################################################################################
# SET hdfs.setwd() before using this
    # CODE TO MAKE A LINE OF RANDOM WORDS
################################################################################################
MU.LETTERS = 7 #
MU.WORDS = 10
#make.line poisson distributed number of words and letters per a line (well... subtract 1 and it is true).
#mu.letters must be 2 or more.
#mu.words must be 2 or more.
make.line = function(mu.letters, mu.words){
if(mu.words < 2) mu.words = 2
if(mu.letters < 2) mu.letters = 2
nwords = rpois(1,mu.words - 1) + 1
nletters = rpois(nwords, mu.letters - 1) + 1
words = mapply(function(n) paste(sample(letters,n),collapse=""), nletters)
words = paste(words,collapse=" ")
return(words)
}
#make.line(MU.LETTERS,MU.WORDS)
################################################################################################
# MAKE THE BQUOTE BASED MAP
################################################################################################
map.args = list(MU.LETTERS=MU.LETTERS, MU.WORDS=MU.WORDS, make.line=make.line)
map <- as.expression(bquote({
args = .(map.args)
attach(args)
for(v in map.values){
set.seed(v)
rhcollect(v,make.line(MU.LETTERS,MU.WORDS))
}
detach(args)
}))
################################################################################################
# RHWATCH DETAILS
################################################################################################
input = 10

mapred = list()
################################################################################################
# NEED TO HANDLE THE TEXT OUTPUT FORMAT
################################################################################################
mapred$mapred.field.separator=" "
  mapred$mapred.textoutputformat.usekey=FALSE 
  mapred$rhipe.eol.sequence= "\n"
 
 
 
mr = rhwatch(map=map, input=input, output=output, mapred=mapred, jobname=jobname)
